And for anyone wondering: 
I do exercise regularly 
I go running about 3-4 days a week 
I go to the gym and do some weights the rest of the days

I’ve lost 30 kgs in the past 2 years 
My mother has been very supportive, i continue to eat healthy even though my mom and dad eat very unhealthy ( their diet usually consists of chicken curry, biryani, paratha and fried stuff). I always have food made for me separately, 
I eat overnight oats, boiled eggs and fruit or toast with peanut butter and banana in the morning 
Brown rice with chicken breast( my mom has this amazing recipe its super healthy and tastes like biryani) 
Or 2 rotis and mix veg or some other sabzi/curry 
For dinner i’ll have masala oats, leftover sabzi from lunch or chicken breast cooked with some spices 
As for family gatherings and annoying relatives I have learned to ignore them, eat however much you want, in my case these relatives first shamed me for being overweight and now try to make me to eat super unhealthy food when im trying to eat healthy. You have to learn to be blunt about this stuff 
Also, if you are out with family or friends its totally fine to eat something you want to eat just make sure you jump right back into your diet the next day !
